isolation: Each scenario's Given state (rooms, bookings) was attempted fresh through the deployed rooms-api, either read via GET /rooms or created via POST /me/bookings with a freshly-minted test-member bearer token, so no scenario depended on data left behind by another. In this run every such attempt was refused uniformly at the gateway (404, envoy, {"error":"Not Found"}) before reaching the application, so no scenario actually created or observed shared state; the one exception, the signed-out visitor scenario, touches no rooms-api state at all and was isolated by using a session with no prior sign-in.
